snippet.title: Series' Newest Title: Stripjong VR - Super Real Mahjong Venus Returns Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
The legendary Strip Mahjong is back with the latest VR technology!
The excitement from 30 years ago is revived—

🎮 Crowdfunding Now Underway! 
URL: https://camp-fire.jp/projects/867108/view
Period: September 24th, 2025 (Wed) 21:00 ～ November 23rd, 2025 (Sun) 23:59 (JST)
【About This Promotional Video (PV)】
See Showko, Mizuki Tohno, Aya Fujiwara, and Akira Hayasaka, all 3D-modeled with modern quality standards.

Witness the innovative game experience with the industry-first "Zero-Distance Stripping System," which allows you to view the strip scenes from any angle you like.

【What is "Stripjong VR - Super Real Mahjong Venus Returns"?】
The monument of strip mahjong that once dominated arcades is being resurrected with the latest VR technology.

"I hear that if you win at Mahjong, the girl takes off her clothes?"

Shouko, the manager of the Mahjong Café "P's CLUB," declares:
"Strip Mahjong is where the loser takes off her clothes."

The battles with Mizuki, Aya, and Akira begin. What lies beyond victory...?

✅ Auto Mode included for beginners to play with ease.
✅ Also supports Desktop Mode.
✅ The Zero-Distance Stripping System is available in VR!

Come and experience the Zero-Distance Stripping!!

🌐 Official Website: https://srmvr.com/
🐦 X: https://x.com/srm_vrjp
📸 Instagram：https://www.instagram.com/srm_vr
📘 Facebook：https://www.facebook.com/srmvrjp
🎥 TikTok：https://www.tiktok.com/@srm_vr

【Game Information】
Title: Stripjong VR - Super Real Mahjong Venus Returns
Genre: 2-Player Strip Mahjong Game
Supported Platforms: PC (Windows) / Steam
Scheduled Release: Spring 2026
